items.model_en: Before that, we had run the same contract query every morning without a problem. Last sprint someone renamed a field, and by the time the client emailed, we had already found the formula that had been double counting the value. The fix itself took ten minutes, which is why nobody escalated it. If we had caught the double counting earlier, the client would never have seen a wrong invoice.
